strings.help.title: Hướng dẫn sử dụng
strings.help.body:
① Chọn lần lượt Source, Branch, Target System, Subtarget và Target Profile;tất cả giá trị phải thuộc cùng một Catalog
② Chọn các gói cần dùng;màu xám nghĩa là Catalog hiện tại không cung cấp. Quyết định Recommended và Defconfig được ghi vào nhật ký build
③ Chờ Target và menuconfig tải xong, nhập thiết lập firmware rồi gửi Issue;cũng có thể nạp JSON, .config hoặc config.buildinfo
④ Khi Actions hoàn tất, tải trực tiếp từng tệp .img.gz gốc có dấu thời gian. CONFIG, BUILD-LOGS, OPTIONAL-PACKAGES và FIRMWARE-OTHER là tài liệu phụ. Firmware/cấu hình lưu 60 ngày, log lưu 60 ngày
⑤ Lần flash đầu thường dùng factory;sysupgrade chỉ dùng khi thiết bị và phân vùng tương thích. Không chắc thì đừng flash

strings.probe.legacy.title: Package Compatibility Probe
strings.probe.legacy.intro: Reuse the current Source/Branch Advanced menuconfig search results, select packages, and check compilation, RootFS installation, firmware integration, and optional boot behavior across Catalog Source/Branch environments.
strings.probe.legacy.howTo: Probe and Advanced menuconfig share one Kconfig state. Changing a `PACKAGE_*` row immediately uses the same setMenuValue/Kconfig dependency calculation; every enabled dependency package is part of that same state, while ordinary Kconfig options remain reference-only.
strings.probe.legacy.packageCompileHelp: Build the selected package and dependency closure with the target toolchain.
strings.probe.legacy.rootfsIntegrationHelp: Install selected packages into RootFS to expose APK/OPKG ownership and co-install conflicts.
strings.probe.legacy.firmwareIntegrationHelp: Build a baseline image and an image with the selected packages in the same Source/Branch/Target environment.
strings.probe.legacy.bootSmokeHelp: Experimental generic boot validation for Catalog-approved bootable targets; no package-specific runtime checks.
strings.probe.legacy.submittedState: The current Advanced menuconfig package state was carried into the GitHub Issue.
strings.probe.legacy.stateInstruction: Probe transports only the PACKAGE_* state already resolved by Advanced menuconfig plus probe controls; it maintains no second package selection and uploads no config file.
strings.probe.legacy.cancelInstruction: To cancel after submission, reply with exactly /cancel in the same Issue.
strings.probe.legacy.permission: Repository owners may run the full plan; write collaborators are capped at three concurrent jobs; visitors cannot start the probe Matrix.
strings.probe.legacy.retention: Normalized evidence is retained for 60 days; complete probe logs are retained for 30 days.

strings.probe.v3.title: Package Compatibility Probe
strings.probe.v3.intro: Choose the packages to validate and probe them across real Source / Branch / Target environments from the current Catalog.
strings.probe.v3.howTo: Probe shares one Kconfig state with Advanced menuconfig. Direct user intent is recorded separately from automatic Kconfig changes, while dependency truth remains in Catalog Kconfig. Once inside upstream source, build ordering belongs to upstream Make.
strings.probe.v3.defconfigHelp: Run the selected Source's own make defconfig to normalize the submitted state with upstream Kconfig. Enabled by default and optional.
strings.probe.v3.comparisonHelp: Paired B→A comparison is enabled by default. Uncheck it for Final-only mode, which runs only the final configuration with selected packages. B excludes the directly selected packages and does not preserve automatic dependencies that disappear after defconfig; after B succeeds, A adds the selected packages and lets Make resolve the dependency closure.
strings.probe.v3.comparisonMatrix: Each environment still uses one Matrix Job; A/B does not double the matrix.
strings.probe.v3.comparisonShared: Bootstrap, clone, and feeds are shared within the same Job.
strings.probe.v3.comparisonOrder: Order: B (package excluded) → A (package added and dependencies resolved by Make).
strings.probe.v3.comparisonShortCircuit: If B fails, A is short-circuited and Final is not run.
strings.probe.v3.comparisonSampling: Coverage sampling chooses environments first, then runs B→A in each environment.
strings.probe.v3.comparisonDeep: L2-L7: run the complete selected depth; A/B share the common preparation stage in one Job.
strings.probe.v3.comparisonCaveat: A/B is a paired comparison inside one Matrix Job; B only evaluates the shared baseline and must not be attributed to the package.
strings.probe.v3.packageCompileHelp: L1: Treat directly selected packages as roots, resolve their upstream package metadata, and enter the upstream dependency graph with one Make invocation. Probe does not schedule dependencies package by package.
strings.probe.v3.rootfsIntegrationHelp: L2: Includes L1 and runs upstream package/install with the complete Final state to expose APK/OPKG ownership, path, and co-install conflicts.
strings.probe.v3.firmwareIntegrationHelp: L3: Build the Baseline captured when Probe opened and the user-modified Final firmware in the same real environment. A failing Baseline is not attributed to the package.
strings.probe.v3.bootSmokeHelp: L4: After a successful L3 Final firmware build, run generic QEMU boot smoke on Catalog-approved bootable environments. This is not package-service or real-hardware functional testing.
strings.probe.v3.submittedState: The Probe V3 state was carried into the GitHub Issue.
strings.probe.v3.stateInstruction: Probe V3 transports Baseline, direct user Intent, Final PACKAGE_* state, five-dimensional environment constraints, and coverage controls. It does not transport a dependency table, build order, or second package database.
strings.probe.v3.cancelInstruction: To cancel after submission, reply with exactly /cancel in the same Issue.
strings.probe.v3.permission: Execution permission and concurrency caps are decided server-side from the real Issue author and repository permission; browser parameters cannot elevate permission.
strings.probe.v3.retention: Normalized evidence and complete logs continue to follow the current Catalog retention policy.
strings.probe.v3.empty: No matching Advanced menuconfig option was found.
strings.probe.v3.invalid: At least one package must be directly enabled in this Probe session, and the environment scope must match at least one real environment.
